required_context: active view projection and viewport size
camera position, direction and up vector
required_artifacts: error number and message for rejected cases
capture_contract.comparison_rule: Capture source facts first. Do not fill expected numeric geometry from the web implementation.

cases.title: Two exact semantic points, default placement
setup: Use two P-Points or other exact semantic points with a non-zero 3D separation.
Use a view where the point-to-point direction is not parallel to the view direction.
actions: Create a linear dimension.
Pick point A, then point B.
Place the dimension line with the default style and commit.
capture: dimension direction, projection direction and offset
rendered line, extension lines, arrows and label
assertions: The displayed value equals the E3D-derived point distance.
Semantic attachments survive save and reopen.
Rendered geometry can be reconstructed from semantic data and placement attributes.

cases.title: Camera rotation preserves design-space placement
setup: Reuse the committed dimension from E3D-GOLDEN-001.
actions: Capture the dimension in the creation view.
Orbit the camera to two materially different non-degenerate views without editing the dimension.
capture: dimension database attributes before and after orbit
assertions: Semantic anchors and stored dimension frame do not change when only the camera changes.
Only view projection and text orientation are allowed to change.

cases.title: World-axis projected dimension
setup: Choose two points with non-zero X, Y and Z deltas.
Use World X as the measured projection axis.
actions: Create the projected dimension and place its projection lines.
assertions: Measured axis and projection-line direction are captured as different fields.
The displayed length matches the absolute X projection.

cases.title: Semantic pipe-axis direction and reversed sense
setup: Use a BRAN/TUBI or component that exposes a stable axial direction.
actions: Create one projected dimension along the semantic direction.
Repeat after reversing the direction sense.
capture: signed internal projection and displayed value
assertions: The semantic source and direction sense are recoverable after reopen.
Reversal changes direction semantics without losing the anchor source.

cases.title: Positive and negative offset placement
setup: Use the same anchors and frame for both captures.
actions: Place the dimension line on one side of the anchors.
Move or flip it to the opposite side with the same absolute offset.
assertions: Offset is stored in design units and is reproducible from the placement point and frame.
Cancel restores the pre-edit placement.

cases.title: Short dimension with outside text and arrow reversal
setup: Choose anchors whose projected separation is shorter than the formatted label plus arrow clearance.
actions: Create and place the dimension using the default E3D style.
assertions: The short-dimension policy is explicit and repeatable.
Text and arrow placement do not overlap.

cases.title: Rejected near-parallel direction combinations
setup: Prepare one dimension direction parallel to view.
Prepare one projection direction parallel to view.
Prepare one projection direction parallel to the dimension line.
actions: Attempt each invalid creation or edit separately.
Repeat just outside the rejection tolerance.
capture: E3D error number and full message
whether any database element was committed
assertions: Invalid input is rejected before a visible or persisted dimension is produced.
The observed boundary can be represented by deterministic tolerance tests.

cases.title: Four-point chain with back-step and finish
setup: Prepare four ordered exact points on a common usable frame.
actions: Enable chain mode.
Pick four points, remove the latest point once, add it again, then finish.
capture: command prompts for add, back and finish
assertions: Point order is durable.
Adjacent segments share one baseline and placement frame.
Back-step does not leave an orphan dimension point.

cases.title: Minor/major arc and near-orthogonal snapping
setup: Prepare ray pairs at exact 90 degrees, within approximately 0.9 degrees of 90, and clearly outside that band.
actions: Create minor and major angular dimensions.
Repeat with orthogonal snap enabled and disabled if E3D exposes that control.
assertions: Minor/major choice is durable.
The runtime threshold for orthogonal snapping is measured rather than assumed.

cases.title: Radius and diameter from the same circle
setup: Use one circular or arc primitive with a known center, rim and normal.
actions: Create a radius dimension.
Switch the same semantic geometry to diameter display.
Move the leader and label before committing.
assertions: Radius and diameter share the same geometry source.
Display semantic changes do not duplicate or alter the source circle.

cases.title: Metric, imperial and angular formatting matrix
setup: Use one exact length and one exact angle whose conversions expose rounding and trailing-zero behavior.
actions: Capture mm, cm, m, inch and feet/inch presentations at at least two precision settings.
Capture decimal-degree and any alternate angular presentation exposed by E3D.
capture: complete formatted string including symbols, spaces, signs and zeros
assertions: Formatting is centralized and independent of persisted geometry.
No web expectation is accepted without an E3D-produced string.

cases.title: Referenced object moves between model revisions
setup: Create a dimension whose points are attached to movable model elements.
actions: Save and reopen the dimension.
Move or revise one referenced element.
Refresh or reopen the drawing.
capture: behavior when the reference is deleted
assertions: A valid reference re-resolves instead of remaining at only the old coordinate.
A missing reference produces an explicit degraded or error state and is not silently deleted.

cases.title: GRIDPL/GRIDCY automatic annotation lifecycle
setup: Open a drawlist containing grid planes or cylinders with automatic dimensions enabled.
actions: Capture the initial annotations.
Add and remove a grid member.
Refresh the same view and then switch to another view.
capture: generated annotation count and source grid refs
assertions: Only GRIDPL/GRIDCY changes trigger this source.
Generated records are view-derived and not editable user dimensions.
Deletion clears stale generated annotations.

cases.title: Cancel, restore and undo boundaries
setup: Start from a saved linear dimension and record all relevant attributes.
actions: Cancel during first-point, second-point, frame-selection and placement stages.
Edit offset then cancel.
Commit one edit and undo it.
capture: attribute values before edit, after cancel, after commit and after undo
assertions: Cancel leaves no partial child elements.
Cancelled edits restore prior values.
One committed placement edit maps to one undoable intent.
